body:
hi @caroheymes.

Have you tried using InstantSearch.js, it will help you make your implementation more concise? Maybe you could give it a spin with the [getting started](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/getting-started.html)?

I'm saying this because your implementation does not use InstantSearch.js and here we handle InstantSearch.js issues. The idea to add links to any other resources is to add them directly in your results as links. You could store those links in the algolia dataset, or you can have id's that you can reuse to create links based on a  "template", like "http://mywebsite.com/product/${id}"
